title: Zullen we? — aanbod en belofte
summary: zullen for offers (zal ik…?), suggestions (zullen we…?), promises and predictions

blocks.title: Het werkwoord zullen
blocks.body: *zullen* is your all-purpose 'shall / will' verb. Like *gaan*, it sits **second** and sends its partner infinitive to the **end**. Three everyday jobs: an **offer**, a **suggestion**, and a **promise**.
blocks.callout: *jij zult* is a touch formal; *jij zal* is what most people say out loud.

blocks.title: Zullen we…? — the classic suggestion
blocks.body: Open a plan with **Zullen we…?** — literally 'Shall we…?', the Dutch way to propose doing something together. The infinitive lands at the end: *Zullen we koffie **drinken**?* Answer *ja, leuk!* or *nee, liever niet*.
blocks.callout: *Zal ik…?* = an offer from just you: *Zal ik het raam opendoen?* (Shall I open the window?)

items.en: Shall I give a quick call?

pairs.note: *Zal ik* betaalt: one person does it. *Zullen we* pulls everyone in: a shared plan.

blocks.title: Belofte en voorspelling
blocks.body: *zullen* also makes a **promise**: *Ik zal het niet vergeten* (I won't forget it). And with *wel* it softens into a **prediction/guess**: *Het zal wel druk zijn* (It'll probably be busy). That little *wel* means 'probably'.
blocks.callout: *Het zal wel* on its own = a shrug: 'yeah, probably, whatever.'

blocks.prompt: Your friend looks lost with heavy bags. What do you offer?
blocks.explain: *Zal ik je helpen?* — you alone offer to help. *Zullen we* would mean you both help someone else.

blocks.prompt: Suggest to a friend: 'Shall we go to the cinema?' (naar de bioscoop, gaan)
answers: Zullen we naar de bioscoop gaan?
Zullen we naar de bioscoop gaan
zullen we naar de bioscoop gaan?
blocks.hint: Start with Zullen we, park gaan at the end.
blocks.explain: *Zullen we naar de bioscoop gaan?* — suggestion opener, infinitive last.

blocks.scene: Daan flops into the café chair across from you

lines.speaker: Daan
lines.nl: Joh, ik heb honger. Zullen we een broodje halen?
lines.en: Hey, I'm hungry. Shall we grab a sandwich?
lines.spotlight: Zullen we … halen? — a shared plan.

lines.speaker: You
lines.spotlight: Zal ik…? — you offer to do it yourself.

lines.speaker: Daan
lines.nl: Graag. En ik zal deze keer betalen, beloofd.
lines.en: Please. And I'll pay this time, promise.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Echt? Het zal wel weer 'volgende keer' worden, hoor.
lines.en: Really? It'll probably turn into 'next time' again, you know.

lines.speaker: Daan
lines.nl: Nou! Deze keer niet. Zullen we?
lines.en: Hey! Not this time. Shall we?

blocks.title: Doe een voorstel
blocks.prompt: Build a suggestion or an offer with zullen.
Propose two weekend plans to a friend with *Zullen we…?*, and make one promise with *Ik zal…*.
